entities.name: S3 (source)
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3' at (817,266), AWS_Icon_6. Receives data from Expedia Group and feeds EC2 and Glue. Not inside any box.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'EC2' at (989,161), AWS_Icon_8. Upper processing path between the two S3 buckets. Not inside any box.

entities.name: Glue
entities.rationale: Purple funnel icon labeled 'GLUE' at (985,339), AWS_Icon_5. Lower processing path between the two S3 buckets. Not inside any box.

entities.name: S3 (CSV)
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3 (CSV)' at (1157,256), AWS_Icon_7. Receives output from EC2 and Glue as CSV files. Not inside any box.

entities.name: ECS
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'ECS' at (737,542), AWS_Icon_1. First element of the bottom row, below the orange horizontal separator line/arrow. Not inside any box.

entities.name: Aurora
entities.rationale: Blue database icon labeled 'AURORA' at (923,542), AWS_Icon_2. Second in the bottom row.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'LAMBDA' at (1086,538), AWS_Icon_3. Third in the bottom row.

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Pink queue icon labeled 'SQS' at (1259,537), AWS_Icon_4. Last in the bottom row; a curved arrow goes from it up to Salesforce.

entities.name: Salesforce
entities.rationale: Salesforce cloud logo drawn at top-right as an external SaaS system; target of the curved arrow from SQS. Not inside any container.
